facts.fact: Circular n°5 of 2 September 2026 generalises a technical note of the national security agency (ANSI), requires audits by ANSI-accredited bodies and immediate notification of ANSI of any confirmed or suspected cyber incident.
facts.system: Agence nationale de la sécurité informatique (ANSI)
